query: What are effective ways to reduce urban heat islands?

documents.title: Urban heat mitigation overview
documents.text: Urban trees, reflective roofs, and permeable surfaces can reduce heat exposure.

documents.title: Land-cover strategies
documents.text: Increasing vegetation and reducing heat-absorbing surfaces lowers local temperatures.

documents.title: Community cooling plans
documents.text: Heat action plans combine cooling centers, shade, and public warning systems.
